screen.title: Followers & requests
screen.followers_empty: Nobody follows you yet. Share your link – whoever opens it can ask you.
screen.no_search: There’s no people search in {{app}} – so it stays just between friends.
screen.load_failed: Your followers and requests couldn’t be loaded.

context.unknown: You don’t share an occasion. Do you know {{name}} personally?

card.title: Person
card.self_hint: Your lists and your followers are under “Wishlists”.
card.cannot_request: You can ask through a shared occasion, a follow link – or once {{name}} follows you.
card.lists_none: {{name}} isn’t sharing a list with followers right now.
card.lists_hidden: You’ll see the lists once you follow {{name}}.

giver.unfollow_message: You won’t see {{name}}’s lists any more. Your reservations there will end.

accept.title: Request from {{name}}
accept.sees_none: You’re not sharing any list with followers right now.
accept.sees_unknown: Which lists your followers see is shown on each list under “Who sees this list?”.
accept.also_title: Would you like to follow {{name}} too?

decline.done: Declined. {{name}} won’t be told. You won’t see new requests from {{name}} for 30 days.
decline.failed: Declining didn’t work – the request is back.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} as a follower?
remove.message: {{name}} won’t get a message but won’t see your lists any more. Whatever {{name}} secretly planned for you will be cancelled – whether there is anything, you’ll never find out.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.point_see: You won’t see each other any more – not in requests, lists or guest lists.
block.point_occasions: {{name}} is no longer a guest at your occasions, and you are no longer one at {{name}}’s.
block.point_others: At other people’s occasions you both stay guests but won’t see each other there.
block.point_message: {{name}} won’t get a message but won’t see your lists any more.
block.point_plans: Whatever {{name}} secretly planned for you will be cancelled – whether there is anything, you’ll never find out.
block.links_switch: Also switch off all my follow links
block.links_hint: Otherwise someone could come back with another account through an old link.
block.done_links: {{name}} is blocked – your follow links are switched off
block.links_failed: {{name}} is blocked. Your follow links could not be deactivated. Try again under “Privacy”.

unblock.title: Unblock {{name}}?
unblock.message: Nothing comes back: earlier follows, requests and places at occasions stay ended.

report.pending: Contact details will be added before the pilot starts
report.mail_body: What did you notice? Describe it briefly – we’ll get back to you.

link.title: Your follow link
link.hint: Whoever has the link can only ask you. You decide who sees your lists.
link.valid_new: A new link is valid for {{days}} days – until {{date}}.
link.five_links: You have {{max}} active links – sharing switches off the oldest one.
link.shared_toast: Whoever opens it sends you a request – you confirm it under “Requests”.
link.copy_failed: Copying didn’t work – press and hold the link to copy it yourself.
link.share_text: Follow me on {{app}} – then you’ll see the wishlists I share with followers.
link.revoke_message: Nobody can ask you through your previous links and codes any more. Your followers stay.
link.revoked: All your follow links and codes are now switched off

add.title: Add friends
add.tabs: How do you want to add someone?

code.hint: Show your code: whoever scans the QR code with their phone camera or types the code into {{app}} under “Enter code” can ask you. You decide.
code.renewed: New code – the previous ones no longer work.

enter.lead: Ask your friend to show you their code or read it out.
enter.label: Code
enter.hint: 8 characters. Upper or lower case and the dash do not matter.
enter.shape: A code has {{count}} characters – letters and digits.
enter.invalid: This code is wrong or has expired. Ask for the current one.

gate.title: Follow link
gate.lead: Someone wants to share wishlists with you.
gate.what_is: After signing in you’ll see who it is and decide for yourself.
gate.soon_text: Following and shared wishlists are coming to {{app}} soon.
gate.fact_name: With your request {{name}} sees your name “{{me}}”.
gate.fact_consent: Only once {{name}} agrees will you see the shared lists.
gate.fact_stop: You can stop following at any time.
gate.requested_text: {{name}} decides. As soon as {{name}} agrees, you’ll see the shared lists.
gate.own_text: Share it with friends – whoever opens it can ask you.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.suggestions_hint: Guests of shared occasions from the last 30 days then see you under “From your occasions” and can ask you.
privacy.suggestions_failed: The setting couldn’t be saved – it’s back to how it was.
privacy.who_private: “Only me” – every new list starts like this. Nobody but you sees it.
privacy.who_followers: “My followers” – people whose request you confirmed.
privacy.who_occasion: Guests of an occasion see that occasion’s wishlist.
privacy.who_direction: Following goes one way: whoever follows you sees your lists – you see theirs only once you follow them too.
privacy.who_suggestions: Suggestions from occasions only exist if you switch them on.
privacy.who_photos: Your profile picture and banner photo are seen only by people who can see your profile: followers, people you follow or who asked to follow you, and guests of shared occasions – never anyone blocked.
privacy.who_secret: You never see reservations on your wishes.
privacy.who_followers_list: Only you see your list of followers.
